title: Rabbi Yaakov bar Abba (I), Rav’s Student

paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov bar Abba (I). A student of Rav.

In Bava Batra 41a he interprets a teaching before Rav. At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:11, Rabbi Yaakov bar Abba asks Rav about intercourse with a minor girl. Rav says: “Although Rabbi Yaakov bar Abba defeated me in the legal argument, the ruling is…” etc.

Sanhedrin 66b reads Yaakov bar Ada; it should read bar Abba, as in Dikdukei Soferim and Tosafot on Kiddushin 10a, under ad sheyihu. Zohar, Lech Lecha 92b, has Rabbi Abba coming from Tiberias to Bei Tronya with his son Rabbi Yaakov.

notes.text: The full Jerusalem Talmud passage names Rabbi Yaakov bar Abba in Rav’s “defeated me in argument” statement. The Zohar citation remains Hyman’s separate reference, not an adopted identity crosswalk.

The consulted Guggenheimer Sanhedrin 7:11 names Yaakov bar Abba as the questioner and the person Rav says defeated him in argument. Vilna Tosafot on Kiddushin 10a, ad sheyihu sheneihem shavin, also reads Yaakov bar Abba. The exact Dikdukei Soferim reading and the Zohar occurrence remain separately attributed; the latter does not establish identity.
